claude.rationale: At closing the Plan splits the previously shared two-business group into two independent companies (radio/audio retained by Reorganized iHeart; outdoor-advertising as New CCOH), with the radio business first transferred to a newly formed subsidiary and CCOH merged into a surviving renamed vehicle — a 1-to-N split at T2/T3/T4. gap_45=0 because the customer-facing operating assets of each business move together with their respective businesses; there is no documented product-vs-process mismatch at closing. gap_56=0 because the historically shared corporate-services, cash-management, and IP substrate (T5) is not orphaned but is explicitly terminated and re-bridged by a new transition services agreement, a $200M revolver, and tax-indemnity/release provisions, so process is re-engineered coherently alongside the separated organizations rather than transferring without its people/management.

grok.rationale: At closing the Plan separates radio and outdoor into two independent companies, with the radio business transferred to a new iHeartCommunications subsidiary and outdoor concentrated in New CCOH, so customer-facing products move with their respective operating businesses rather than without them (gap_45=0). The same closing structure expressly terminates the shared corporate-services, cash-sweep, and IP/royalty substrate and replaces it with a new transition services agreement (plus a bridge revolver), documenting that shared operational processes were re-engineered without the underlying organization transferring intact and that this mismatch was contractually absorbed by the TSA (gap_56=1, mitigated=yes).

openai.rationale: The Plan split the customer-facing radio/audio and outdoor-advertising businesses into two independent companies, while the previously shared corporate-services, cash-management, and IP substrate was terminated rather than transferred intact. This product-process mismatch was contractually absorbed at closing through a new transition services agreement that superseded the prior Corporate Services Agreement, so gap_45 is documented and mitigated. The slice does not document a corresponding mismatch between the reconfigured processes and the people, management, or culture operating them; therefore no closing-structure gap_56 is documented.
